name: Scrapbook page
summary: One scrapbook page for the semester made together: pick a drawn sticker from the tray (a dumpling, the rice cooker, an alarm clock, the car) and tap the page to slap it down anywhere, tilted and signed with your face; three each, and you can peel your last one off.
useWhen: make a scrapbook page for this semester
everyone add a sticker for fall
a page of our inside jokes
decorate a page for the group together
dontUseWhen: a photo album of real pictures (use album)
signing a card for one person (use bday-pool or cap-signing)
a written recap of the year (use wrapped)

heading.description: Handwritten heading on the page, e.g. 'fall '26'

tray.description: Up to 6 stickers offered, picked to match the group's jokes

stickers.description: Stickers already on the page, at most 3 per person
